title: OpenAgenet / OAN White Paper: Open Infrastructure for Trusted Agent Interconnection
abstract: arXiv:2606.03161v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: OpenAgenet, abbreviated as OAN, is an open infrastructure project for trusted Agent interconnection. It addresses a problem that becomes visible when Agents move from isolated applications into open, multi-operator networks: before an Agent can safely discover, select, and invoke another Agent, it needs a way to verify identity provenance, governance state, discovery authorization, freshness, and pre-connection trust evidence. OAN is designed as a protocol-neutral trust layer. It does not replace Agent interaction protocols, tool protocols, model orchestration frameworks, or application-level workflows. Instead, it provides \texttt{did:oan}-based resource identity, governance-backed admission, Registrar-assisted onboarding, Root-verified package publication, authorization-aware Discovery, Root-issued infrastructure authorization VCs, and signed trusted invocation. translated_title: OpenAgenet / OAN 白皮书：可信智能体互联的开放基础设施
translated_abstract: OpenAgenet（简称 OAN）是一个面向可信智能体互联的开放基础设施项目。它解决的是当智能体从孤立应用进入开放的、多运营商网络时显现的一个问题：在智能体能够安全地发现、选择并调用另一个智能体之前，它需要一种方式来验证身份来源、治理状态、发现授权、新鲜度以及连接前的信任证据。OAN 被设计为一个协议中立的信任层，它并不取代智能体交互协议、工具协议、模型编排框架或应用级工作流，而是提供基于 did:oan 的资源身份、基于治理的准入机制、注册机构协助的接入流程、根验证的软件包发布、授权感知的发现服务、根签发的基础设施授权可验证凭证（VC），以及签名化的可信调用。OAN 的架构核心是联邦……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: OAN 提出了一个协议中立的信任基础设施层，通过基于 did:oan 的资源身份、治理准入、根验证发布、授权感知发现和签名可信调用等机制，解决智能体在开放多运营商网络中安全互联时的身份验证与信任建立问题。
en_tdlr: OAN proposes a protocol-neutral trust infrastructure layer that enables secure Agent interconnection in open multi-operator networks by providing did:oan-based resource identity, governance-backed admission, Root-verified publication, authorization-aware Discovery, and signed trusted invocation.
